openMSX V9990 reference snapshot
===============================
Repository: https://github.com/openMSX/openMSX
Revision: a557de7b37bc48420b63ec10e7ede953babad4f9
Retrieved: 2026-10-26
Original directory: src/video/v9990/
Original authors: see authors.txt (upstream doc/authors.txt).
License: GNU General Public License version 2; see ../../COPYING.

Upstream README states that files without an individual notice use the
GPL text in doc/GPL.txt. These selected source files contain no overriding
license. No proprietary V9990 BIOS, fonts, game ROMs or sample data is included.

V9990.cc / V9990.hh: port/register numbering, access/write masks, register
selection, VRAM read buffer, palette stepping/masks, reset and IRQ semantics.
V9990VRAM.cc / .hh: 512 KiB, power-on fill and P1/P2/Bx CPU address transforms.
V9990DisplayTiming.hh: unified 42,954,540 Hz clock and NTSC/PAL constants.
V9990BitmapConverter.cc: B1 BP4/BP6 pixel extraction and palette indexing.

The adjacent original files are reference source, not separately compiled.
The modified/adapted implementation is ../../src/v9990.c, rewritten in C
with fixed storage, a small explicit-time scheduler and a scanline RGB API.
The command engine, pattern/sprite rasterizers, SDL integration, save states,
debugger, Tcl settings and openMSX device/motherboard dependencies are NOT
ported. This is not a complete drop-in extraction of openMSX's V9990 device.

Modifications made in 2026 for neo9990: portable C adaptation, subset guards,
native boot/GPIO/framebuffer integration and tests. All new firmware files
in this subtree use GPL-2.0-only. Retain these notices and ship corresponding
source, build scripts and COPYING with any distributed derived binary.
The repository's hardware/documentation license is not changed by this file.
